decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel remains central to the firm's binding mobile communication strategy, even though it no longer appeared on the website in 2020–2021, which suggests possible rebranding or integration.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the conceptual backbone of the integrated offer, so it is more likely folded into the platform messaging than formally withdrawn.
Hardware QR tokens still serve PSD2 transaction-authorization niches with banks, but the shift to app-based authentication and the product's absence from the website make a withdrawal plausible.

The payment network compliance suite is peripheral to the firm's move toward one secure identity across channels, and its disappearance from the website suggests resources are better spent on the core identity platform.
